vqa_items.question: As a relationship or mentorship network, can every important person or entity, role group, primary and advisory link type, label, and direction be traced without ambiguity through clean spatial organization and professional network-diagram craft?

score_criteria.2: Award 2 only if the network is exceptionally clear and presentation-ready: nodes and role groups are immediately distinguishable; primary, advisory, and any directional relationships use fully consistent and unmistakable encodings; important links remain traceable despite network density; labels are readable; spacing and grouping reveal structure; and connector routing is balanced with minimal tangling. The result must look deliberately composed, with no ambiguous direction, hidden edge, detached connector, illegible label, unstable node spacing, clipping, or rendering flaw. Any uncertain relationship prevents 2.
score_criteria.1: Award 1 if the network structure is understandable and usable, but it has visible imperfections such as some tangled links, small labels, weak role grouping, modest relationship-type distinction, uneven node spacing, or generally generic network styling.
score_criteria.0: Award 0 even if nodes and links are present when the network is visually difficult or unreliable to interpret: important connections cannot be traced, relationship types blend together, direction is ambiguous, labels are unreadable, layout is tangled, or substantial redesign is required. Blank, corrupted, severely unreadable, or materially incomplete networks are also 0.
